subject: History

intro: Lesson 15: Norman castles. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Label a motte and bailey castle

keywords.def: a tall mound of earth with a tower on top
a yard with a fence around it
taking over a land by force
the main tower of a castle
when people fight against their rulers

questions.q: Why build a motte and bailey castle first?
questions.a: It was quick and cheap, so control came fast
Stone does not burn or rot
The White Tower (Tower of London), or another such as Rochester

questions.q: Core: Label the motte and bailey diagram and write one sentence for each part about how it helped the Normans.
questions.a: Labels with uses, for example motte: lookout and last defence

questions.q: Extend: Explain why castles helped so few Normans control so many English.
questions.a: Soldiers could control the land around and stay safe inside

questions.q: Stretch: Would you rather attack a wooden or a stone castle? Why?

questions.a: B) The earth mound. The motte is the mound; the bailey is the yard.

questions.q: Norman castles were first built of:
Big question: why build a castle in a few weeks?
questions.a: To control the area fast after the conquest and protect the few Normans from rebellions
